01 / about

I'm a full stack developer with four years building digital publishing products at Aeon Media. Within a five-person engineering team, I grew into primary backend responsibility. I work across Ruby on Rails, AWS, GraphQL, TypeScript and React/Next.js, collaborating closely with editorial and production teams.

My experience spans backend APIs, web interfaces and infrastructure. I'm experienced in using OpenAI Codex and Claude for code generation and reviews to improve code quality and speed up team delivery.

Before software development, I worked in IT and network support. I studied biomedical science at Monash University from 2017 to 2020 and hold a Bachelor of Biomedical Science. I also supported coding students as a teaching assistant at Le Wagon.

English is my native language, and I hold JLPT N2. I'm looking for mid-level or senior full stack roles that let me continue living in Osaka, including remote work within Japan.

Away from the screen: running, hiking, bouldering and exploring Kansai.
